acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Tailwind CSS v4 and @tailwindcss/vite plugin are installed - verify with `npm list tailwindcss` shows 4.x
shadcn/ui dependencies installed (class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge) - check package.json
globals.css contains Linear Violet theme CSS variables - file contains --primary, --background, etc.
components.json is configured for shadcn/ui (New York style, Zinc base) - file exists with correct settings
cn() utility function exists in src/lib/utils.ts - function is exported and works
A test Button component renders correctly with Tailwind styles - button displays with correct styling
`npm run dev` runs without errors - dev server starts successfully

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Commands for Tailwind v4: `npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite`. shadcn/ui deps: `npm install class-variance-authority clsx tailwind-merge`. ADR-004 justifies Tailwind v4 choice for 5x faster builds and CSS-first config.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Linear Violet theme with colors: --primary: #8b5cf6, --bg-base: #09090b, --bg-card: #111113. Typography uses Inter font. shadcn/ui selected as design system.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Prerequisites: Story 1.1. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/vite, run `npx shadcn@latest init` with New York style, Zinc base.

doc.title: Story 1.1: Project Setup & React Installation
doc.snippet: React 19 installed, vite.config.ts has React plugin, tsconfig.json has JSX support. Entry points at src/app/App.tsx and src/app/main.tsx.

artifact.reason: Must be modified to add @tailwindcss/vite plugin alongside existing React plugin. Currently has React plugin only.
Must import globals.css for Tailwind styles to be applied. Currently no CSS import.
Test component for verifying Button renders with Tailwind. Currently has inline styles that will be replaced with Tailwind classes.
Already has React JSX support configured. May need path alias @ for shadcn/ui imports.
Add tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/vite, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge as new dependencies.

constraints.constraint: Core logic files (src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/) must NOT be modified.
Use Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS-first configuration - no tailwind.config.js needed.
Use @ path alias for imports (already configured in vite.config.ts).
Use Linear Violet color theme with oklch color values for modern CSS support.
Select New York style and Zinc base color when initializing shadcn/ui.
Story 1.1 must be complete before starting - React and Vite React plugin must be working.
